note: Transitions are scaffolded from data/images.json by `make matrix-scaffold`. no_image verdicts are set from the registry. Every other verdict comes only from verification runs by the upgrader itself (verify/harness.py), on an empty and a seeded database, and names both evidence records. Preflight results from a user's cluster are never written here.

entries.reason: No measured pg12 image ships both 2.0.x and 2.1 or later: pg12.6-ts2.0.1-p0 stops at 2.0.1 and pg12.22-ts2.11.2 ships 1.7.5 and 2.1.0 onwards, so `tsupgrade plan` refuses the row (bridging stalls at ts2.0.1). The target image exists; nothing bridges to it. A pg12 ts2.1.x image might; unmeasured.

Passes only with the stop at 2.27.2 that `tsupgrade plan` inserts. The bridge hop updates the database across 2.15, and TimescaleDB 2.28.2/2.28.3 then fail to update it directly (`cannot drop table _timescaledb_internal.bgw_job_stat_history`, #10272). Fixed in 2.29.0, which drops PostgreSQL 15: no fixed release exists for PG15.
